ideas.title: The Impact of the Government Shutdown on Fraud and Abuse
ideas.description: Investigate the potential consequences of the government shutdown on various programs and services, including the potential for increased fraud and abuse.
questions: What programs are most vulnerable to fraud and abuse during the shutdown?
How can the government mitigate the risks of fraud and abuse during the shutdown?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to uncover significant vulnerabilities in government programs and services, and I recommend pursuing it as a high-priority investigation.
